outcomes.name: Understanding of the skills and learning approach has been assessed across all live sites/teams
The skills and learning approach is consistently applied everywhere the change has gone live

actions.action: Recognise that Skills & Behaviour is inconsistent across teams/sites since go-live and gather evidence of where the gaps are in the skills and learning approach.
Identify why the skills and learning approach hasn't landed consistently for Skills & Behaviour in specific teams/sites and agree a plan to address it.
Re-engage leaders in lagging teams/sites to re-establish the skills and learning approach for Skills & Behaviour.
Confirm the skills and learning approach for Skills & Behaviour is being applied consistently across previously inconsistent areas.
Monitor Skills & Behaviour regularly to ensure the skills and learning approach stays consistently reinforced everywhere.
Survey teams/sites to understand how People Experience & Culture has been affected by inconsistent skills and learning approach since go-live.
Develop a targeted plan to address the specific People Experience & Culture-related gaps identified in lagging areas.
Deliver targeted support to strengthen People Experience & Culture in teams/sites where the skills and learning approach is weakest.
Confirm People Experience & Culture has improved in previously lagging teams/sites.
Embed regular pulse-checks on People Experience & Culture so gaps in the skills and learning approach are caught early in future.
